_doc: AINOS3-115 — NOS3/OnAIR MID field <-> STIX IOB pattern-argument map. NOT complete by design (AINOS3-115 AC5); a seed that grows. Each row is one (stix_object:stix_property -> observable) claim. status: verified = demonstrated live that the field moves as the argument requires (cite evidence); unverified = plausible, not exercised. representable=false: a field exists but cannot hold the argument's value (a distinct state from no-observable). A row with mid=null is a no-observable coverage gap. Schema/field existence is enforced by mid_stix_map.py; regenerate the arg vocabulary with --args.

rows.evidence: rule-gate R15 compares CFE_TIME (MET+STCF) vs NOVATEL GPS time; live-validated 2026-08-25 against a real SET_TIME (0x1805 FC7) — the FSW-clock side of the delta moves and is detected
rows.notes: GNTM-6/7 time-controller delta. The GPS-input side (GNTM-5/9/10) is a SEPARATE row and is unverified — see below.

rows.evidence: R15 reads this field, but only a FSW-clock move (SET_TIME) has been exercised; a GPS-time SPOOF that moves NOVATEL itself (GNTM-5/9/10) has NOT been demonstrated — 'recorded is not verified' (AINOS3-96)
rows.notes: Verifying this needs the EX-0014.01 GPS-spoof script (AINOS3-118 AC2).

rows.evidence: R15 has rewind/backward-jump handling that would catch a GNSS time rewind, but no GNSS-rewind attack has been run
rows.notes: GNTM-9. Same verification dependency as the row above.

rows.evidence: rule-gate R16 (cf-command); live-validated 2026-08-26 with a real CF NOOP (0x18B3 FC0) — counter new-high detected at the attack frame, 0 FP in 3170 nominal frames
rule-gate R6 (sb-command); EX-0012.02 route-severance live-validated (project history)
rows.notes: The R6-R13 family: static-in-nominal command counters. One exemplar row; siblings CFE_EVS_HK/CFE_ES/CFE_TBL/FM/TO.CommandCounter follow the same claim.

rows.evidence: field exists and carries a table-validation CRC, but no attack has been shown to move it in a way a detector reads
rows.notes: Table CRC, not a full memory/file hash. Distinct from file:hashes below.

rows.evidence: AINOS3-109: the only checksum we subscribe is (a) PRUNED from the CSV, (b) computed once in CFE_ES_TaskInit and NEVER recomputed, (c) a uint16 CRC, not a file hash
rows.notes: representable=false is the point: a field nominally exists but cannot hold 'expected_hash_value' nor change at runtime. The real fix is the CS app (AINOS3-111).

rows.evidence: AINOS3-87: the switch bitfield is recorded but EX-0012.09 was NOT detected in steady flight; whether the pattern's target-subsystem semantics are met is open
the cFS Software Bus is anonymous publish/subscribe — a packet carries no sender identity (AINOS3-95 GEN-ACCESS-IN). SBN forwards telemetry-out only.
rows.notes: 282 IOB patterns reference network-traffic:* — the single largest STIX object, and structurally unobservable here. A standing coverage gap, not a TODO.

rows.evidence: no process-introspection telemetry; the cs/hs/mm/md apps that would surface app/task state are not even built (AINOS3-110..113), and below the startup-script '!' terminator
rows.notes: 132 IOB patterns reference process:*. CFE_ES_APP_TLM (per-app exec counter) is the nearest partial and is a deferred subscription (AINOS3-120).

rows.evidence: CryptoLib is a CFE_LIB with zero Software Bus telemetry (project history); key state lives in the SADB, off the bus
rows.notes: 55 IOB patterns reference cryptographic-key:*. Off-bus by construction.
